assets.title: Estimate Your College Cost
assets.summary: This current federal guide links the Net Price Calculator Center, College Navigator, College Scorecard, and aid-offer comparison tools so counselors can help students compare total and net college costs.

assets.title: EDP Fundamentals Guide
assets.summary: Michigan’s revised guide details the grade 7 launch, annual updates, statutory elements, talent portfolios, career clusters, work-based learning, and counselor responsibilities for student Educational Development Plans.

assets.title: Perceptions of Career Technical Education: A Research Update
assets.summary: This 2025 national perceptions update shows what parents value in CTE, persistent participation misconceptions, and tested messages counselors can use when discussing hands-on career pathways.

assets.title: Becoming an Officer in the Military After College
assets.source: Military OneSource, U.S. Department of Defense
assets.summary: This current overview compares ROTC, service academies, officer candidate school, Coast Guard pathways, eligibility, scholarships, and service commitments for college-bound students considering commissioned service.

assets.title: Law, Public Safety, Corrections and Security
assets.summary: This student-facing federal page compares public-safety civilian careers, majors, salaries, outlooks, and related military occupations so counselors can discuss transferable pathways and training options.

assets.title: Steps for Students Filling Out the 2026–27 FAFSA Form
assets.source: Federal Student Aid, U.S. Department of Education
assets.summary: This current walkthrough explains each student section of the 2026–27 FAFSA, contributor invitations, dependency questions, financial entries, and school selection so counselors can prepare seniors and troubleshoot common completion errors.

assets.title: Writing Guide for Counselors and Teachers
assets.summary: This concise guide distinguishes counselor and teacher recommendation roles and gives concrete examples for describing leadership, academic achievement, context, and student fit in college application letters.

assets.title: Producing the Goods of the Future: Job Opportunities in Manufacturing
assets.summary: This current federal outlook compares growing manufacturing industries and occupations, projected openings, wages, and education or training requirements, giving counselors data for exploring technical and degree-based pathways.

assets.title: Michigan Career Outlook Through 2032
assets.source: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics
assets.summary: This state report organizes Michigan’s in-demand occupations by education and training level and highlights STEM pathways, helping counselors connect student plans with projected openings and wage ranges.

assets.title: Learn About the U.S. Military Branches
assets.summary: This neutral federal comparison summarizes the six service branches, their missions, member names, reserve components, and special operations, supporting an introductory counselor-led exploration of military options.

assets.title: Military Tuition Assistance
assets.summary: This federal guide explains ROTC and branch scholarship programs, service commitments, Coast Guard college pathways, and education benefits so counselors can discuss military-connected college funding accurately.

assets.title: College Navigator
assets.source: National Center for Education Statistics, U.S. Department of Education
assets.summary: This free federal search and comparison tool lets counselors and students filter colleges by programs, location, cost, admissions, institution type, and other characteristics, then save, compare, map, and export results.

assets.title: FAFSA Submission Summary: What You Need To Know
assets.source: Federal Student Aid, U.S. Department of Education
assets.summary: This federal walkthrough helps counselors guide students through estimated aid, Student Aid Index, school information, corrections, verification, and next steps after a FAFSA is processed.

assets.title: Education Level and Projected Openings, 2024–34
assets.summary: This federal outlook compares occupations with the most projected openings across five education levels, pairing each pathway with wages, experience, training, and skill information for data-informed student planning.

assets.title: Michigan Pathfinder
assets.source: Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
assets.summary: This one-page state guide introduces Michigan’s free Pathfinder tool for matching skills to careers, comparing education costs with employment outcomes, and building training paths and Educational Development Plans.

assets.title: Joining the Guard or Reserves
assets.source: Military OneSource, U.S. Department of Defense
assets.summary: This federal guide explains Guard and reserve eligibility, training, drill schedules, activation, service commitments, benefits, and branch contacts so counselors can help students compare part-time military service with active duty.

assets.title: Future Servicemember Preparatory Courses: Background and Issues for Congress
assets.summary: This nonpartisan federal report explains military entry standards and preparatory courses that address aptitude or physical-fitness gaps, giving counselors current context for students who may not initially qualify to enlist.

assets.title: Common App Case Studies
assets.summary: This counselor-ready activity package uses a fictional college and applications to help students and families practice holistic admissions review and discuss how context, academics, writing, activities, and institutional priorities shape decisions.

assets.title: Do You Need Money for College or Career/Trade School?
assets.source: Federal Student Aid, U.S. Department of Education
assets.summary: This federal student guide explains aid eligibility, FAFSA accounts and deadlines, dependency status, grants, work-study, loans, aid offers, and next steps for college or career/trade school.

assets.title: Explore Apprenticeship Opportunities for Young People
assets.summary: This federal two-page resource explains how pre-apprenticeship and Registered Apprenticeship can begin during high school or dual enrollment, combining paid work, related coursework, credentials, and postsecondary pathways.

assets.title: Healthcare, Science, and Engineering Careers That Don’t Require a 4-Year Degree
assets.summary: This 2026 federal outlook compares growth, wages, education, experience, and training for healthcare, science, and engineering occupations that typically require less than a bachelor’s degree.

assets.title: Basic Training
assets.source: Military OneSource, U.S. Department of Defense
assets.summary: This federal guide compares branch-specific basic training length, locations, expectations, physical and academic demands, required documents, prohibited items, and preparation tips for prospective recruits.

assets.title: Advancing in the Military
assets.source: Military OneSource, U.S. Department of Defense
assets.summary: This federal guide explains enlisted, warrant, and commissioned pathways, officer preparation, service academy options, military job assignment realities, advancement, and links between military specialties and civilian careers.

assets.title: Application Dictionary
assets.summary: This six-page glossary defines admissions plans, application roles and forms, financial-aid terms, transfer concepts, and counselor responsibilities, giving counselors a concise reference for clarifying college-application language with students and families.

assets.title: FAFSA® Checklist: What Students Need
assets.source: Federal Student Aid, U.S. Department of Education
assets.summary: This current federal checklist identifies the accounts, contributor details, tax records, child-support data, assets, and school list students need for the 2026–27 FAFSA, helping counselors structure completion preparation.

assets.title: Michigan Hot 50 Job Outlook through 2034
assets.source: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics
assets.summary: This two-page state outlook lists 50 Michigan high-demand, high-wage occupations with annual openings, projected growth, wage ranges, and typical education or training, supporting data-informed career conversations and EDP planning.

assets.title: 2026 Registered Apprenticeships in Michigan Report
assets.source: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics and Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
assets.summary: This Michigan report examines 2025 apprenticeship participation, occupations, industries, regions, demographics, and one- and five-year wage outcomes, giving counselors evidence for explaining paid training pathways and local demand.

assets.title: Military Common Questions
assets.summary: This official student FAQ answers common questions about eligibility, branches, recruiters, service commitments, education benefits, job training, specialty selection, and MEPS, helping counselors organize balanced pre-recruiter discussions.

assets.title: Military Recruiting: Actions Needed to Address Digital Marketing Challenges
assets.summary: This independent federal review explains how military services market to Gen Z, summarizes youth and mentor perceptions, and evaluates recruitment websites and digital practices, helping counselors teach students to assess recruiting messages critically.
